title.narrative: Adoption of legislative package for Energy Performance of Buildings and enforcement.

description.narrative: This indicator captures compliance of Georgian reform with the EnC accession protocol and commitment to EE in the building sector.

comment.narrative: The Progress Report of this intervention covering period up to 15 September 2021 under section f on page 12 indicates that implementation of Energy Efficiency Component 1 focusing on Supporting establishment of legislative and regulatory environment for energy efficiency is expected to start from Q4 of 2021 onwards.
